0022600108.text: The Bulls (1-1, 7th in the East and 2nd in the Central, 0.5 games back) host the Wizards (1-1, 5th in the East and 2nd in the Southeast, 1 game back), with Chicago on a one-game winning streak and Washington coming off a loss. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring), while Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Bulls won the 2025-26 series 3-0, including a 119-108 win in Washington on April 9, 2026.
